snippet.title: Cuboid Sandbox (Development timelapse) - Ludum Dare #24
snippet.description:
Try it for free here: http://www.subvertgames.com/ld24play

Half game and half simulation, this sandbox let you discover the beauty and wilderness of the different Cuboid species fighting for food and territory control in a constantly evolving environment.

Music: Kevin MacLeod (http://incompetech.com/) licensed under CC BY 3.
